reuse.why: The change shares category exclusions and reuses tag, sheet, batching and undo helpers, but setBulkNMonthAvg duplicates work already encapsulated by setNMonthAvg.

duplication.why: Category queries are consolidated, but average calculation/sign handling remains duplicated and income eligibility is repeated across bulk actions.

placement.why: Budget policy stays in budget/actions.ts and method registration follows the existing app.ts layering.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested bulk actions, their registration and related tests.

maintainability.why: The shared exclusions improve maintenance, but scattered income policy, duplicate average orchestration and a query return type claiming unselected fields weaken the design.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: setBulkNMonthAvg directly calculates, signs and writes averages instead of using setNMonthAvg, which the original six- and twelve-month actions called.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: setBulkNMonthAvg reshapes setNMonthAvg's average/sign/write sequence around an already-loaded category, leaving equivalent orchestration in both functions.

abstraction_drift.where: getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional hidden filter; setBulkNMonthAvg introduces one shared implementation site bypassing setNMonthAvg for the bulk average paths.
